Future<void> save(Object? x) async {}
Future<bool> busy(int i) async => false;
Future<bool> isFree(int i) async => true;
Future<void> handleA(Object? e) async {}
Future<void> handleB(Object? e) async {}
Future<List<int>> loadRows() async => [];
Future<int> load(int i) async => i;

class Event {
  final String type;
  Event(this.type);
}

// CASE multi_body expect=fire
Future<void> a1(List<int> rows) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = rows.length; i < n; i++) {
    await save(rows[i]);
  }
}

// CASE reverse_empty_update expect=fire
Future<void> a2(List<int> rows) async {
  for (var i = rows.length - 1; i >= 0;) {
    await save(rows[i]);
    i--;
  }
}

// CASE empty_body_comment_block expect=fire
Future<void> a3() async {
  for (var i = 0; await busy(i); i++) {
    /* spin */
  }
}

// CASE empty_body_line_comment expect=fire
Future<void> a4() async {
  for (var i = 0; await busy(i); i++) {
    // spin
  }
}

// CASE empty_body_semicolon_multi expect=fire
Future<void> a5() async {
  for (var i = 0, j = 1; await busy(i + j); i++);
}

// CASE multi_triple_quote expect=fire
Future<void> a6(List<int> rows) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = rows.length; i < n; i++) {
    await save('''
      Don't skip ${rows[i]}
    ''');
  }
}

// CASE multi_nested_interp expect=fire
Future<void> a7(List<Map<String, String>> rows) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = rows.length; i < n; i++) {
    await save('${rows[i]['name']} {');
  }
}

// CASE multi_raw_backslash expect=fire
Future<void> a8(List<String> rows) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = rows.length; i < n; i++) {
    await save(rows[i].split(r'\'));
  }
}

// CASE multi_braced_return expect=pass
Future<int> a9(List<int> ids) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    if (await isFree(ids[i])) return ids[i];
  }
  return -1;
}

// CASE multi_braceless_return expect=pass
Future<int> a10(List<int> ids) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) if (await isFree(ids[i])) return ids[i];
  return -1;
}

// CASE multi_collection_body expect=fire
Future<List<int>> a11(List<int> ids) async {
  return [for (var i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) await load(ids[i])];
}

// CASE single_collection_body expect=fire
Future<List<int>> a12(List<int> ids) async {
  return [for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) await load(ids[i])];
}

// CASE switch_braceless_forin expect=fire
Future<void> a13(List<Event> events) async {
  for (final e in events)
    switch (e.type) {
      case 'a':
        await handleA(e);
        break;
      default:
        await handleB(e);
    }
}

// CASE switch_braced_forin expect=fire
Future<void> a14(List<Event> events) async {
  for (final e in events) {
    switch (e.type) {
      case 'a':
        await handleA(e);
        break;
      default:
        await handleB(e);
    }
  }
}

// CASE multi_init_once expect=pass
Future<int> a15() async {
  var total = 0;
  for (var rows = await loadRows(), i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    total += rows[i];
  }
  return total;
}

// CASE callback_nested_classic expect=fire
Future<void> a16(List<int> ids, void Function(Future<void> Function()) register) async {
  for (final id in ids) {
    register(() async {
      for (var i = 0, n = 3; i < n; i++) {
        await save(id + i);
      }
    });
  }
}

// CASE callback_only expect=pass
Future<void> a17(List<int> ids, void Function(Future<void> Function()) register) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    register(() async {
      await save(ids[i]);
    });
  }
}

// CASE multi_braceless_body expect=fire
Future<void> a18(List<int> rows) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = rows.length; i < n; i++) await save(rows[i]);
}

// CASE callback_comment_for expect=pass
Future<void> a19(List<int> ids, void Function(Future<void> Function()) register) async {
  for (final id in ids) {
    register(() async {
      // Replaces for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) in the old code
      await save(id);
    });
  }
}
